name: datacenter-osint
features: Map loads with data centers, thermal power plants, heavy industry, cooling towers and drought layers that toggle.
Region picker loads CA, AZ, NV, Southwest or the whole country, and each area caches for the session.
Satellite imagery shows true color, water vapor and infrared, with play the last day and latest image.
Trace the vapor downwind draws a plume path at plume, ground or mid sky level, and clear removes it.
Wind flow layer shows on the map.
